purpose: The whole vote for **Fungu 68** for FY2025/26, carried from appropriation through to the release position at three quarters of the year. notes: THE BUDGET-CREDIBILITY FINDING (FY2025/26 to March 2026).** Nine months into the year, **50.6%** of the vote had been released. Development spending — 95% of the vote — stood at TZS 139.89bn of TZS 277.05bn (50.5%), and the split matters: **domestic development money was 56.3% released (TZS 55.41bn of 98.48bn) against 47.3% for external (TZS 84.48bn of 178.57bn)**. On this evidence the external half of Tanzania's digital build is the slower half to arrive, not the faster. · Read it with the following year.** FY2026/27 (`tza-2027-68`) asks TZS 222.59bn, with external development finance cut to TZS 110.96bn while domestic development finance holds at exactly TZS 98,480,905,000 for a second year. A vote that under-released its external tranche in FY2025/26 is then budgeted for less of it. · Revenue outperformed while spending under-released**, which is worth stating together: the backbone earned 133.5% of its revenue target in the same nine months the vote spending it released half its money. · Recorded `partial`** under the envelope rule — the ministry's whole vote, not a digital line — and **not to be folded into a headline digital total**. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average TZS/USD rate is held. · `released_total` is rounded to the shilling** in frontmatter (TZS 147,768,795,247); the speech's own figure to the cent is 147,768,795,246.62 and is carried in the stage history and the table above. · Built under `INGEST.md` step 2a** from 2026-04-30-tz-hotuba-bajeti-mawasiliano-2026-27; the appropriation baseline is corroborated by 2025-05-16-tz-hotuba-bajeti-mawasiliano-2025-26.
